# One-By-One Repo Study Template

Use this exact section order when mode is `one-by-one`.

## 1. Repo Positioning
- One-sentence purpose.
- Why now in learning order.
- What this repo is not.

## 2. Relationship Diagram
- Mermaid graph from this repo to upstream/downstream repos.
- Include at least one dependency edge and one handoff edge.

## 3. Inputs, Process, Outputs
- Inputs: configuration/assets/tools consumed.
- Process: main responsibilities and execution flow.
- Outputs: artifacts, state changes, or downstream triggers.

## 4. 60-90 Minute Study Plan
- Step 1: README and docs orientation.
- Step 2: folder and entrypoint mapping.
- Step 3: one end-to-end path tracing.
- Step 4: summarize findings.

## 5. Common Pitfalls
- 3-5 high-frequency misunderstandings.

## 6. Self-Check
- 3 questions that prove understanding.
- Pass rule: all 3 can be answered without notes.

## 7. Next Repo
- Exactly one recommended next repo with reason.
- Mention what to focus on next.
